title: Bossbear
description:
Years after losing touch as children, Jude and Serena unexpectedly reunite as college students in Toronto. But when a mysterious explosion leaves Serena’s best friend severely injured, the two begin investigating and uncover a conspiracy far bigger than they ever imagined.
One involving a secret agency, dangerous technology, and someone hiding in plain sight. Their investigation will change their lives forever.

title: Godfidence
description:
When strength fails, what do you put your faith in?
Godfidence follows Jay, a young boy caught in a situation far beyond his control—where courage, faith, and the power of God collide. Sometimes, confidence isn’t enough. You need Godfidence.

title: The Last Dance
description: A story of faith, friendship, growth, and a life lived through dance. The Last Dance is coming soon.
